record.author: d-2
record.title: Anticoagulation review
record.body: Patient with atrial fibrillation on warfarin. INR 3.6, above the target range of 2 to 3. Reduced the warfarin dose from 5 mg to 4 mg daily and booked a repeat INR in one week.

record.author: d-2
record.title: Heart failure follow-up
record.body: Ankle swelling improved since furosemide was increased to 40 mg. Weight down 2 kg. Continue the low-salt diet and daily weights; call if weight rises more than 2 kg in three days.

record.author: d-4
record.title: Knee replacement, six weeks
record.body: Six weeks after total knee replacement. Flexion 105 degrees, wound healed. Physiotherapy twice a week continues; stop the walker and use a cane outdoors.

record.author: d-4
record.title: Wrist fracture
record.body: Distal radius fracture, cast applied. Recheck X-ray in two weeks to confirm alignment before switching to a removable splint.

record.author: d-9
record.title: Anticoagulation start
record.body: New atrial fibrillation. Started apixaban 5 mg twice daily instead of warfarin; no INR monitoring needed. Kidney function checked and normal.

record.author: d-2
record.title: Chest pain assessment
record.body: Exertional chest pain for two weeks. ECG normal at rest. Stress test ordered; start aspirin 75 mg and carry glyceryl trinitrate spray.

record.author: d-6
record.title: Diabetes review
record.body: HbA1c 64 mmol/mol, up from 58. Metformin continued at 1 g twice daily; added empagliflozin 10 mg. Foot check normal; retinal screening due in March.

record.author: d-2
record.title: Pacemaker check
record.body: Routine pacemaker interrogation. Battery longevity eight years, leads stable, no arrhythmias recorded since the last check.

record.author: d-2
record.title: Note entered in error
record.body: Beta blocker bisoprolol stopped because of dizziness and a heart rate of 48. This note was later deleted as entered in error.

record.author: d-3
record.title: Hypertension
record.body: Home blood pressure average 152 over 94. Amlodipine increased from 5 mg to 10 mg. Recheck readings in four weeks.

record.subject: INR result
record.body: Repeat INR came back at 2.4 after the warfarin dose change, now in range. Keep 4 mg daily.

record.subject: Physio referral
record.body: Physiotherapy referral sent for the knee replacement patient; first session booked for Monday.

record.subject: Apixaban refill
record.body: Pharmacy asked to confirm the apixaban dose for the refill: 5 mg twice daily confirmed.

record.title: Warfarin monitoring protocol
record.body:
# Warfarin monitoring

Check the INR weekly after any dose change until two results in a row are in range, then every four weeks.

# When to call the doctor

Call the doctor the same day for an INR above 5 or any bleeding.

record.title: Fall prevention after surgery
record.body: After hip or knee surgery, patients use a walking aid until cleared by physiotherapy. Remove rugs and add night lights at home.

record.title: Refill requests
record.body: Refill requests are answered within two working days. Controlled drugs need a doctor's review every time.
